detail: Full summary: Blast radius of wrong entity scope is bounded to relevance, not correctness. Only two consumers, both in context-assembler: getRelatedEntities (:1080) runs query(scope, limit 5) which substring-matches name OR properties with NO name filter, so a wrong scope property puts wrong files into related_entities in every assemble briefing; computeGraphReachability (:960) queries 20 candidates then filters by NAME, so a wrong scope cannot produce a wrong result there but can crowd a correct entity out of the 20 slots. Nothing does exact scope-equality filtering.
